answer: Sybil resistance in the Proof of Agent network is realized by binding each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement known as MRENCLAVE. This cryptographic binding ensures that any attempt to clone an identity demands the physical acquisition of silicon rather than the facile duplication of a virtual machine. Consequently, at the summit of network operations, the crystal-clear attestation at every vertex maintains the integrity of the consensus mechanism, thwarting adversarial sybil attacks effectively.
